summary: A Felucca-based multi-engine synth firmware with a dark, industrial and Brazilian character: self-evolving drones, manguebeat drum kits and grit effects meant for live play, across four tracks.
features: 13 engines, including Dexed-editable FM6 and a ladder-filter ANALOG
Drone mode with "EVOL" random walks and a "TENS" tension ramp over bars
Industrial and maracatu, baião and coco kits; 49 factory beats with fills
64-step sequencer per track with chance, ratchets, Euclid and 13 arp modes
Tape, hum, dust and per-track distortion; 16 hold-to-play punch-in effects
USB and TRS MIDI, clock in and out, MIDI learn; USB audio; 4 projects
